name: CUE7
summary: The seventh in Toyota's basketball-shooting robot line, cut from 120 kg to 74 kg and rebuilt on an inverted two-wheel base. It measures the hoop with cameras and LiDAR, then a hybrid controller — reinforcement learning over model predictive control, trained on human motion data — computes the arc and force for each shot.
notable: Hybrid reinforcement-learning and model-predictive control trained on human motion
Successor to CUE3's 2,020 consecutive free throws and CUE6's 24.55 m record shot
